fields.Name: Cash
fields.Description: Cash / bank account the money lands in (payment-time entries).

fields.Name: Accounts Receivable
fields.Description: The AR control account debited when a sale is booked before payment.

fields.Name: Inventory
fields.Description: Inventory asset account. Nothing in Accounting posts to this role yet.

fields.Name: Cost of Goods Sold
fields.Description: Cost of goods sold expense account. Nothing in Accounting posts to this role yet.

fields.Name: Sales
fields.Description: Revenue account credited when a sale is recognized.

fields.Name: Sales Discounts
fields.Description: Contra-revenue account for discounts granted on sales.

fields.Name: Sales Returns and Allowances
fields.Description: Contra-revenue account for returned goods / allowances.

fields.Name: Deferred Revenue
fields.Description: Liability account credited for revenue not yet earned (subscriptions).

fields.Name: Processing Fee
fields.Description: Payment processor fees expensed at capture (orders D18). The gateway keeps its cut, so cash lands NET while the customer's receivable is relieved GROSS; this role names the expense account carrying the difference. Without it the fee is not booked and cash reads gross by that amount.

fields.Name: BankAccount
fields.Description: Cash / bank GL account that counts toward the company's cash position. Many per company, date-effective. NOT used for payment posting — that is role Cash, which stays singular. Read by FP&A to build CashBalance as the sum of a company's Active BankAccount links at a point in time.

fields.Name: Unbilled Receivable
fields.Description: Contract-asset account for revenue earned ahead of billing (orders D92). It is debited when revenue is recognised beyond what an order line has been billed, and credited when a later instalment invoice bills that amount down — so it holds service already delivered that the contract does not yet allow us to bill, while Accounts Receivable means billed and unpaid. Maps to 11300 Unbilled Revenue (Contract Asset), one company-level link per company. With no link, orders refuses an entry that needs this leg and names the role and the company; nothing is posted.

fields.Name: Customer Deposits
fields.Description: Liability account for cash received against an order instalment that has not been invoiced yet (orders #234). A payment credits it for the part no invoice covers, a refund of that cash debits it, and issuing the instalment clears it against Accounts Receivable, so the balance is only ever money held ahead of billing. Resolved like every other role: product, product category, product type, then company. Finance may link it to a dedicated Customer Deposits account or to the Deferred Revenue account; the entries are the same either way. With no link, orders refuses a payment that needs this leg and names the role and the company.

fields.Name: Gift Card Liability
fields.Description: Liability account for what the company owes on gift cards sold and not yet spent. Orders credits it when a gift card is sold, since the sale earns no revenue, and debits it when the card is spent as a tender. Resolved like every other role: product, product category, product type, then company. With no link, orders books the gift card to the Deferred Revenue account instead and logs a warning; the entry balances, but the two obligations cannot be told apart on the balance sheet.
